remarks: Welcome to this generously sized 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit at Spinnaker Cove, just steps from Cove Island Park, the beach, and the Long Island Sound. The spacious living area boasts new flooring, a natural fireplace, and a private balcony. The kitchen leads to a versatile dining area that can also function as a den or home office. The large bedroom features two sizable closets and a second outdoor balcony. Both balconies have been recently updated with new sliders. Additional highlights include ample closet space, an in-unit washer/dryer, a private storage unit, and one covered, assigned parking space. Residents also have access to a common room perfect for large gatherings and plenty of visitor parking. Conveniently located near I-95, Chelsea Piers, the train station, and downtown.
